negotiable.body: The posting does not list an amount (for example, it says 面議 or 依公司規定). Taiwan's Employment Services Act, Article 5, lets an employer leave pay unlisted only when the regular monthly wage is NT$40,000 or more.
negotiable.notAFigure: That rule is for employers. It is not this job's pay, and pay that a posting does not list is never estimated here.
negotiable.lawLink: Read Article 5 in the national law database
negotiable.filterHint: Jobs that say 面議 have no listed pay. Turn on “Only jobs that list pay” to hide them.

admin.title: Company job boards
admin.subtitle: Public company job boards, read into the job list every 6 hours. Each posting keeps its company name and a link to the original.
admin.notAuthorized: Only admins can see this page.

add.title: Add a company job board
add.tokenHint: The company's id in its job board address.
add.countryHint: Two letters, for example TW. Used only to place a posting that names a city but no country.

list.title: Boards
list.loadError: The list could not be loaded. Try again.

admin.offNote: Turning a board off or removing it takes its open jobs out of the job list. Turning it back on reads the board again.

run.queued: {company}: the board lists {listed} jobs. They are being added to the job list now.
run.waiting: {company}: the board lists {listed} jobs. They will be added at the next scheduled run.
run.error: {company}: the board could not be read. {problem}

errors.duplicate: This board is already in the list.
errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.

problem.board_not_found: The board was not found. Check the board id.
problem.timeout: The board took too long to answer. Try again later.
problem.not_json: The board sent something other than job data.
problem.unexpected_shape: The board's job data was not in the expected format.
problem.unsupported_job_board: This job board system is not supported.
problem.redirect: The board tried to send us to another address, so it was not read.
problem.response_too_large: The board's job list was too large to read.
problem.rate_limited: The board asked us to slow down. It will be tried again later.
problem.server_error: The job board system had a problem. It will be tried again later.
problem.refused: The job board system refused the request.
problem.network: The board could not be reached.
problem.other: Something went wrong while reading the board.
